behaviors: All292 source lines read: directory picker, text read/write, tree listing, Git fixed-key prefix and ignore protocol, supervisor home. Rust handler dispatch opens the canonical path verbatim and preserves output shapes.

Exact5MiB success and one-byte overflow refusal, invalid UTF8 and binary NUL refusal, directory refusal, invalid-content no-truncation and null-content truncation are covered by actual filesystem operations. Ambient file access is independent of picker home.
New0755 parents and0644 files plus preservation of an existing0751 file are tested in a child process with umask0. Missing home yields an empty supervisor-home result without creating relative state.

Actual helper argv and NUL-delimited nonASCII/newline filenames are observed by an authored executable. Real repository filtering and bytewise directory-first listing remain covered; cancellation and named-pipe refusal run in library tests.
intentionalChanges: Rust bounds actual read bytes and checks opened regular-file identity; Go stat plus ReadFile did not bound growth after stat. This is not a universal filesystem TOCTOU guarantee.

Owned Git capture has explicit byte/time limits and cancellation cleanup. Missing Git or non-repository errors still leave the listing unfiltered. Supervisor directory-creation errors are surfaced rather than swallowed.
